##### Project general facts

Bellavista is a prestigious residential development featuring three towers commanding far-reaching views across a spectacular master development, surrounded by green fairways and offering access to world-class amenities. This exceptional project offers studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed with space allocation and breathtaking views that make it perfect for new beginnings. From the moment residents enter the elegantly styled lobby, they experience the refined ambiance that sets the scene for their arrival home.

The development offers a temperature-controlled swimming pool, state-of-the-art gymnasium, steam room, and sauna, along with ample parking and access to extensive community amenities. Residents enjoy landscaped gardens, separate men's and women's changing rooms, and elevators to all floors with security access control. The community provides everything residents need, from world-class retail and leisure spaces to spectacular outdoor living across a prestigious master development.

Each apartment features ceramic tiled floors throughout, painted plastered walls, and double-glazed windows in all rooms. Kitchens are fully fitted with cabinetry, stone countertops, and premium appliances including refrigerators, cookers, kitchen hoods, and washing machines with drying options. Bathrooms feature ceramic tiles, showers, standard sanitary ware, and mirrors, while thoughtful specifications ensure comfort and convenience throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

This development is situated within a master community that spans an extensive area, offering opulent lifestyles, world-class retail and leisure spaces, along with spectacular outdoor living. The community features villas, townhouses, apartments, and branded residences, all enjoying seamless access to amenities and attractions including a renowned golf club and expansive parklands. Nature takes pride of place with green zones, fishing lakes, stables, petting farms, and dog parks, while little golfers can enjoy mini golf and adventurous ones can try the skate park and outdoor ice rink.

The community offers everything residents will need with world-class venues and facilities for tennis, football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, and other sports. Residents can spend lively afternoons at the events park, sample something new at the outdoor food market, or host a barbecue by the lake. With a convenient location close to major road networks, the city centre is within easy reach.

The area's strategic positioning ensures that residents can enjoy both the tranquility of suburban living and convenient access to urban attractions. The community's thoughtful planning and extensive amenities create a pleasant environment perfect for living, resting, and unwinding. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of natural beauty, sporting excellence, and community spirit, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious master developments.
